summary: Tazewell County, VA tower on East River Mountain; 1967 and 1969 vandalism reports; FFLA lists it as standing; no build date, height or current access found.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing by FFLA; no recent description, photo or condition report found

access.note: No public access information in the sources read; ask the owner before visiting

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only history is two newspaper reports from 1967 and 1969 (Bluefield Daily Telegraph, as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page) plus the FFLA listing. No build date, height, design or access information found. Not in the NHLR or FFLOS Virginia listings in the local crawl. The 1969 report calls it the Forestry Department's tower; the record's agency field is still empty. Current condition unverified. Two web searches used. Worth a look in Bluefield Daily Telegraph archives if a construction date is wanted.
